snippet.title: Iman Gadzhi
snippet.description: My name is Iman Gadzhi. I started this channel in 2015: before I’d found any success - so scroll back to see me trying to be a personal trainer, the harsh realities of dropping out of high school, building one of the leading online advertising agencies, all the way through to me making +$100m by the age of 26: I don’t hide anything.
